title: join_label_message space-join branch (for '?'/'!' labels) has no test
detail: New function's True branch exists only for the '?' listing_source label; no test renders that error or asserts the join, so a regression to 'Where did you find this listing?: msg' ships unchecked.
recommended_fix: Add a form_with_errors render with a listing_source error asserting 'Where did you find this listing? <msg>', or a unit test on join_label_message covering both the '?'/'!' and colon branches.

title: Prep-block checklist item 6 pinned only by a non-distinguishing 'one visit' substring
evidence:
form_view_test.gleam:375-378:
  // Honest time + one-visit expectations.
  html
  |> string.contains("About 15 minutes, once you have the documents")
  |> should.be_true
  html
  |> string.contains("one visit")
  |> should.be_true

The new constant (form_copy.gleam) still contains the substring: "...You don't have to finish in one visit. Once your email is in, your answers save as you go..."; the removed one-visit paragraph also contained "in one visit". By contrast the email surface IS pinned distinctly (email_client_test.gleam:551-555):
  html
  |> string.contains("save as you go")
  |> should.be_true
  html
  |> string.contains("doesn't save your progress")
  |> should.be_false
detail: The 'one visit' substring matches both the removed one-visit paragraph and the new save-as-you-go line, so a revert of the prep-block item 6 passes CI; the email surface is pinned, the form surface is not.
recommended_fix: Mirror the email test in form_view_test: assert the prep block contains 'save as you go' and no longer contains 'doesn't save your progress'.
